summary: Voters in the Ghaziabad city seat mostly cite waterlogging and jams after rain, potholes and dirty drains in Vijay Nagar Sector 12, the unfinished Vijay Nagar bridge and the Vijaynagar exit, while the appreciation found is limited to works that have only been launched, such as the Vijay Nagar road and park works and the Gamni bridge foundation.

round2.changes: Opened all 10 cited item URLs and corrected wording to what each article says: removed unsupported claims (the 2022 district waterlogging line, 'for months' and 'flood the main road' in N1/N2, 'traffic jam' and 'recently' in N4, 'for many years' in N5, 'no timeline' for the councillor). Replaced P4 (Gadkari overbridge direction, an official announcement alone) with the Gamni bridge foundation (Star Express, 22 Sep 2026), now P1. Dropped the Morta, Vaishali, Radha Kunj and Rahul Vihar works (Amar Ujala 9 Oct 2026) and the Ghaziabad Junction station jam, as outside AC 56 or unconfirmed. Shortened Hindi to 11-13 words. Re-ranked. Added round2 block and ac_specific_negatives.

positives.english: The foundation has been laid for the Gamni bridge from Vijay Nagar to Bagu
positives.hindi: विजय नगर से बागू तक गांमी पुल की नींव रख दी गई
positives.basis: Star Express News (22 Sep 2026): MP Atul Garg and city MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid the foundation for a bridge of about Rs 13 crore over the Delhi-Meerut Expressway, linking Vijay Nagar with Krishna Nagar-Bagu; ceremony at Vijay Nagar Bypass; completion targeted in about one year. Foundation only, not built. AC membership inferred from the Vijay Nagar location (see notes).

positives.english: Road and park works worth about Rs 1.26 crore have started in Vijay Nagar
positives.hindi: विजय नगर में सड़क और पार्क के 1.26 करोड़ के काम शुरू हुए
positives.basis: Udaybhoomi (14 Jul 2026): Mayor Sunita Dayal and MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid foundation stones for four works costing about Rs 1.26 crore in Vijay Nagar: a green belt boundary wall in Ward 14 (Sarvodaya Nagar) and Ward 15, Shastri Park development (no ward given), and road construction in Ward 35 (Akbarpur Beharampur). Launched, not completed. Ward 15 and 35 are on the AC ward list; Ward 14 is not.

positives.english: The Hindon Elevated Road has been built and runs from Rajnagar Extension to UP Gate
positives.hindi: हिंडन एलिवेटेड रोड बन गई, राजनगर एक्सटेंशन से यूपी गेट तक चलती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia: 10.3 km grade-separated road from Raj Nagar Extension (city) to UP Gate at the Delhi border, in operation since March 2018. Older than 2024-2026 but a delivered benefit. AC membership of the stretch is unconfirmed.

positives.english: CC road work has started at the district hospital
positives.hindi: जिला अस्पताल में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू हुआ है
positives.basis: Upabtak (16 Jul 2025): MLA Sanjeev Sharma inaugurated CC road work at the District Hospital (MMG), from the TB department to the mortuary; the MLA's media adviser said it would be completed soon. Started, not completed. The article does not state the hospital's AC; AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: The MLA has written a letter to the corporation about cleaning the toilets
positives.hindi: विधायक ने शौचालयों की सफाई के लिए नगर निगम को चिट्ठी लिखी
positives.basis: Weak positive, a demand with no action: Jan Sagar Today (29 Aug 2026): MLA Sanjeev Sharma wrote to the Municipal Commissioner seeking regular, scheduled cleaning and repair of more than 50 public toilets in the Shahar assembly constituency. The article says attention is now on the corporation's response; no corporation action is reported.

negatives.english: When it rains, underpasses and roads fill with water and jams build up
negatives.hindi: बारिश में अंडरपास और सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026, rain on 5 Sep): the NH-9 underpass in Vijaynagar Industrial Area was closed by water; about one foot of water in Karpuri Puram; water in Govindpuram and Vijayanagar sectors 3 and 9; main road jammed for about half an hour. TNP News (17 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Sadar seat): waterlogging, poor drainage and traffic jams listed as major election issues. Only the Vijaynagar underpass is named as inside Vijay Nagar; Karpuri Puram and Govindpuram AC membership unconfirmed.

negatives.english: In Vijay Nagar Sector 12 roads have potholes and the drains are not cleaned
negatives.hindi: विजय नगर सेक्टर 12 में सड़कों पर गड्ढे हैं, नालियां साफ नहीं होतीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026), Vijayanagar Sector 12 C Block (about 7,000 residents): resident Shekhar said there are big potholes and accidents and complaints go unheeded; Rahul Singh said drains not being cleaned cause major problems in the rainy season. Ward councillor Omveer Singh Odh said repair work is ongoing and the remaining issues will be fixed soon. No ward number is given for Sector 12.

negatives.english: Every day we have to cross the road at the Vijaynagar exit, risking our lives
negatives.hindi: विजयनगर निकासी पर रोज जान जोखिम में डालकर सड़क पार करनी पड़ती है
negatives.basis: Udaybhoomi (4 Sep 2025): residents say they must cross the expressway daily at risk to their lives; the article says a traffic policeman died in an accident near the Vijaynagar exit earlier. Gadkari has directed officials to begin an overbridge process; this is a direction, not a built overbridge.

negatives.english: The Vijay Nagar bridge is still not ready even after five years
negatives.hindi: विजय नगर का पुल पांच साल में भी तैयार नहीं हुआ
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala city-seat issues section (2022 election page; the text is undated): the bridge connecting Vijay Nagar and the city is not ready even after five years. No 2026 report found confirming the bridge's status, so treat as possibly stale.

negatives.english: In Sector 12, drinking water and power cuts are a constant problem
negatives.hindi: सेक्टर 12 में पीने के पानी और बिजली कटौती की दिक्कत रहती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026): resident Rajeev said drinking water and power cuts have been persistent problems and complaints get no response. Single resident's statement.

notes: AC identity: Wikipedia list row 56 Ghaziabad, reserved None, district Ghaziabad. The AC page's extent lists M Corp wards 2-6, 10, 11, 15, 17, 21-23, 28, 29, 35-37, 42, 44, 46, 48, 52, 53, 57, 59; no localities named. 'Sadar' and 'city' refer to this seat (TNP 2026; Amar Ujala 2022 seat page lists 'Vijay Nagar and the city' bridge as a city-seat issue, which is the main source for Vijay Nagar membership). Sector 12 and the Vijaynagar exit and underpass have no ward number; wards 15 and 35 are on the AC list, ward 14 is not, so ward numbering differs between sources. Weak positive kept as flagged: P5 (MLA's letter; a demand with no corporation action). P2 (Hindon Elevated Road) is a 2018 Wikipedia-sourced delivered benefit; AC membership of the stretch unconfirmed. P4 (district hospital CC road) started Jul 2025; hospital's AC not stated. P1 Gamni bridge is a foundation stone only; the road and park works are launches, not completions. N3 is from an undated section of a 2022 page and may be stale. N5 is a single resident. Not found: any 2026 report confirming the Vijay Nagar bridge status, a Vijay Nagar underpass or flyover opening, or completed works in Vijay Nagar. Excluded: Amar Ujala 9 Oct 2026 works (Vaishali, Morta, Radha Kunj, Rahul Vihar; MLA Ajitpal Tyagi, constituency not stated in article); Amar Ujala 8 Aug 2026 jam report (Sahibabad); Ghaziabad Junction station road jam (AC membership unconfirmed). Not used: currentcrime.com Vijay Nagar drain (page did not open, wards 25 and 58 not on AC list); News24 Rs 4.99 crore NH-9 road and drain (Ward 1, Krishna Nagar Bagu, not on AC ward list). Field check suggested for Vijay Nagar bridge status, Sector 12 drains, Vijaynagar exit overbridge, and whether the Gamni bridge foundation was followed by work. P5 weak positive: a letter asking the corporation to clean toilets; no corporation action reported. P1 is a foundation stone only, kept as a started project.
